playlists.description:
This playlist is a musical journey through the planets in Astrology and Human Design. Each song is written to embody the unique energy of a planet, capturing its lessons, blessings, challenges, and spiritual significance. Together, they form a cosmic soundtrack that guides you from self-expression to healing.

Sun – Light of the World: The essence of self and purpose.

Earth – Ground of the Soul: The grounding force and balance.

Moon – Voice of the Heart: Emotional needs and inner drive.

Mercury – Voice of the Mind: Communication, learning, and teaching.

Venus – Heart of Desire: Values, love, and relationships.

Mars – Fire of Growth: Action, passion, and maturity.

Jupiter – Song of Blessings: Expansion, abundance, and meaning.

Saturn – Teacher of Time: Discipline, mastery, and wisdom.

Uranus – Spark of Change: Freedom, uniqueness, and revolution.

Neptune – Veil of Dreams: Spirituality, intuition, and mystery.

Pluto – Flame of Rebirth: Transformation, endings, and rebirth.

Chiron – Wounded Healer: Growth through wounds and guiding others to heal.

These songs connect Astrology and Human Design into sound, reminding us of the universal forces shaping our lives. Listen to discover the cosmic rhythm in your own chart and find inspiration in the planetary energies that guide us all.
